text:
Anna (PM): quick sync — Beacon onramp targeted for next sprint. Need to lock resource swaps + security review timeline. Who can commit to prewarm slots?
Mike (Runtime): we can allocate 2 prewarm GPUs from dedicated pool, need quota increase for afternoon peak. ETA to confirm: EOD today.
Jess (Infra): quota increase request filed, but needs approval from core infra. If we need extra A10s we need payment approval — how critical?
Anna (PM): Beacon requires p95 latency <120ms for gen flows. If we can't get A10s, can we accept p95 ~200ms with fallback?
Kate (Eng): we can add async fallback to smaller model variant; increases complexity but doable in 3 days.
Santhosh (Security): dependency: customer data masking review needs to finish before private deploy. I have one-day slot tomorrow for review if we get docs tonight.
Anna (PM): ok — product accepts soft rollback condition: if masking not cleared, we do hosted-only. Not ideal but unblocks launch.
Mike (Runtime): note re: KV cache priming — for Beacon we need warm keyspaces per-tenant. That'll add ~30MB mem per prewarm instance.
Jess (Infra): that's fine but increases memory pressure. We'll need to bump instance class to m-XL. Cost impact ~+12% for the sprint.
Anna (PM): put numbers in the deck. Is there a blocker from observability side? Need per-tenant token-level traces for post-launch incidents.
Ola (Obs): I can enable token breakdown in staging but will need sampling at 1/10 due to throughput.
Kate (Eng): can we gate the rollout to 10% tenants with full tracing, ramp if OK?
Anna (PM): yes, 10% rollout + canary for perf and correctness.
Santhosh (Security): if we do 10% with traces, I need log retention controls and CI for masking — please share the prompt sets.
Mike (Runtime): I'll wire up adaptive routing to send heavy queries to Dedicated pool during ramp window; config snippet:
```
routing:
  customer: beacon
  policy: adaptive
  fallback: small-variant
```
Jess (Infra): FYI deploy window conflicts with infra maintenance Wed 01:00–04:00 UTC. Can we shift to Thu?
Anna (PM): prefer Thu. Can ops confirm?
Jess (Infra): confirmed Thu is clear.
Kate (Eng): timeline summary: dev freeze Tue EOD, deploy Thu, 10% ramp Thu+Fri, full roll Mon if metrics green.
Anna (PM): outstanding items: 1) quota approval (Jess), 2) security sign-off (Santhosh), 3) prewarm config (Mike), 4) tracing samples (Ola). Owners noted.
Mike (Runtime): I can deliver prewarm config and small-variant mapping by EOD tomorrow.
Santhosh (Security): I'll finish masking review tomorrow noon if I get docs tonight.
Ola (Obs): I'll add sampling config and a dashboard prototype by tomorrow afternoon.
Anna (PM): great — I'll update product board and ping legal for data processing note.
Legal-bot: New DPA required? Please file form DPA-2026-BEACON.
Anna (PM): filed. thanks.
Kate (Eng): adding a tiny follow-up: add rollback script that switches routing policy to hosted-only. I'll draft.
Mike (Runtime): thanks, that'll make rollbacks low-risk.
Anna (PM): ok team — if no objections, I'll lock Thu deploy and owners. :thumbsup: 
Kate (Eng): :thumbsup: 
Jess (Infra): :thumbsup: 
Santhosh (Security): :thumbsup: 
Ola (Obs): :thumbsup:
